mapper.select: SELECT last_connected_at FROM ai_device WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} order by last_connected_at desc limit 0,1

SELECT id, child_profile_id, child_birth_year, child_name, child_age, child_interests, child_interests_json, learning_style, vocabulary_level, parent_career, child_profile_revision, child_profile_payload_hash FROM ai_device WHERE id = #{deviceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_device SET child_profile_id = #{childProfileId}, child_birth_year = #{childBirthYear}, child_name = #{childName}, child_age = #{childAge}, child_interests = #{childInterests}, child_interests_json = #{childInterestsJson}, learning_style = #{learningStyle}, vocabulary_level = #{vocabularyLevel}, parent_career = #{parentCareer}, child_profile_revision = #{childProfileRevision}, child_profile_payload_hash = #{childProfilePayloadHash} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_device SET child_profile_id = NULL, child_birth_year = NULL, child_name = NULL, child_age = NULL, child_interests = NULL, child_interests_json = NULL, learning_style = NULL, vocabulary_level = NULL, parent_career = NULL, child_profile_revision = #{childProfileRevision}, child_profile_payload_hash = #{childProfilePayloadHash} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_device
auto_update = #{autoUpdate}, alias = #{alias}, child_name = #{childName}, child_age = #{childAge}, child_interests = #{childInterests}, learning_style = #{learningStyle}, vocabulary_level = #{vocabularyLevel}, parent_career = #{parentCareer},
WHERE id = #{id}
AND child_profile_revision < 0
